اصطفقوا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَفَقُوا (iṣṭafaqū) /isˤ.tˤa.fa.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِصْطَفَقَ (iṣṭafaqa)
# اِصْطَفِقُوا (iṣṭafiqū) /isˤ.tˤa.fi.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِصْطَفَقَ (iṣṭafaqa)
